card.title: Galaxy A15 5G Does not Charge

claims.statement: Prove the charge port flex, main FPC and battery good before board work; the main FPC is shared across many Galaxy A models (A12, A13 5G, A23 5G, A32, A42 5G, A52, A53 5G, A54 5G, A72, A15 5G).
Charging path: 5 V from the charger, through the OVP, into SM5461, then into the SM5714A IF PMIC which charges the battery.
If CC1/CC2 lines are suspect, their expected diode value is about 0.660.
Most common causes: damaged FPC, blown OVP, faulty IF PMIC.

procedure: Swap charge port flex, FPC and battery.
Check 5 V input on the board with charger connected.
Check 5 V after the OVP; replace OVP if missing.
Check 5 V into SM5461; replace if missing at its output.
Replace SM5714A if 5 V present but no charge.
card.caveats: Test point locations are shown in images on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
